run_main_example_script: run the script to generate all four amortized optimization tutorial PDF figures
generate_opt_contour_plot: generate a contour plot of the objective function f(y; x) with the optimal y* curve
generate_regression_loss_plot: generate a regression-based loss visualization comparing predicted y-hat against optimal y-star
generate_objective_loss_plot: generate an objective-based loss plot showing gradient quivers from predicted to optimal points
generate_rl_loss_plot: generate an RL-based loss plot with perturbed predicted trajectories overlaid on the contour
